verdict.rationale: Rootly documents Workflows as its automation engine, built from trigger events, run conditions, and actions. It ships 152 action types, including incident operations, Slack, Jira, and on-call actions, with Liquid templating for dynamic fields. This explicitly automates response toil such as creating channels, updating stakeholders, filing tickets, and starting retros. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of reminder actions and incident field-change actions, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the workflow engine.
